title: Customer pays through the mock provider without being charged twice

card.i_want: to pay for a confirmed order and see the result honestly
card.so_that: a slow network or a repeated provider message never takes my money twice

intent: The zero double-charge quality KPI holds even when the provider or the customer repeats a signal, which is the difference between a demo and something that can take money.

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: a captured payment moves the order to paid and the stock to sold
given: an order in awaiting-payment with its lines reserved
acceptance_criteria.when: the provider reports a successful capture

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: a replayed provider callback applies once
given: a capture callback already processed for this provider event id
acceptance_criteria.when: the provider sends the identical callback again
then: the order stays paid with no second state change
the stock is not decremented twice and no second charge is recorded

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: a declined payment releases the reservation
given: an order in awaiting-payment with its lines reserved
then: the reserved units return to available

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: a failed payment cannot be re-confirmed as successful
given: a payment already recorded as declined
acceptance_criteria.when: a success message arrives carrying that same payment transaction

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: a delivered order cannot be moved back by a late callback
acceptance_criteria.when: a late provider callback for its original payment arrives
then: the callback changes nothing and the order stays delivered

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: the payment fails after the stock was converted
given: a capture that succeeded at the provider while the local stock conversion did not complete
then: the order does not present as paid with unsold stock
the discrepancy is recorded for back-office resolution rather than silently reconciled
the message reads that the payment was not completed
no wording implies fraud, risk, suspicion or any regulatory concern

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: an admin cancellation after payment compensates the capture
given: a paid order that has not started packing
then: the sold units return to available
a manual refund is recorded with an idempotency key so it cannot be paid twice

pii_fields.justification: the payment amount is financial-class data tied to an identified customer
pii_fields.treatment: visible to the owning customer and the back office only

audit_events.justification: capture, decline and timeout are financial events

idempotency.justification: a replayed provider callback must not apply twice
idempotency.treatment: dedup on the provider event id

reversibility.justification: a capture moves money and cannot be undone in the system
reversibility.compensating_action: manual refund recorded with an idempotency key, dual-approved above 3,000 THB

authn_authz.justification: only the owning customer may pay for the order and only the provider may report its result

regulatory.justification: PCI-DSS v4.0 scope is avoided by never collecting card data; the Electronic Transactions Act governs the confirmation record

tipping_off.justification: customer-facing failure copy must not imply fraud, risk or wrongdoing
tipping_off.treatment: neutral wording reviewed by Legal and UX

edge_case_ledger.justification: a provider event id is an identity, not a magnitude
the terminal payment states are write-once, so a contending second write is the illegal-transition case already written

cases_written: capture succeeded but conversion did not
edge_case_ledger.justification: all derivations for a state-transition rule of this shape were written

cases_written: late callback against a delivered order
edge_case_ledger.justification: the progression is ordinal, not numeric
message wording is a rendering property with no state to contend or repeat
